css: .t1-shell{font:14px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#172033;background:#f7f8fb;border:1px solid #dfe3ea;border-radius:16px;padding:18px;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:100%}.t1-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:18px}.t1-kicker{margin:0 0 2px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:11px;color:#697386}.t1-head h2{margin:0;font-size:22px}.t1-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(76px,1fr));gap:8px}.t1-metrics>div{background:white;border:1px solid #e1e5ec;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;min-width:74px}.t1-metrics strong,.t1-metrics span{display:block}.t1-metrics strong{font-size:18px}.t1-metrics span{font-size:11px;color:#697386}.t1-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.t1-card{appearance:none;text-align:left;width:100%;border:1px solid #dfe3ea;border-radius:14px;background:white;padding:15px;cursor:pointer;color:inherit;transition:.15s box-shadow,.15s border-color,.15s transform;min-width:0}.t1-card:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 8px 22px #17203312}.t1-card.is-active{border-color:#3457d5;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #3457d51f}.t1-card-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.t1-card h3{margin:0;font-size:16px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.t1-badge{font-size:11px;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 8px;background:#eef1f6;color:#455065;white-space:nowrap}.t1-badge[data-status="Active"]{background:#e7f7ee;color:#176b3a}.t1-badge[data-status="Planning"]{background:#fff5d9;color:#8a5b00}.t1-meta{margin:12px 0 0;color:#697386;font-size:12px}@media(max-width:720px){.t1-head{display:block}.t1-metrics{margin-top:12px}.t1-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

const cardsEl=root.querySelector('[data-projects]');const metricProjects=root.querySelector('[data-metric=projects]');const metricActive=root.querySelector('[data-metric=active]');const metricOpen=root.querySelector('[data-metric=open]');function projectStatus(p){return p.status||p.state||(p.id===api.getState('activeProjectId')?'Active':'Planning');}function render(){const projects=api.getState('projects')||[];const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];const activeId=api.getState('activeProjectId');metricProjects.textContent=String(projects.length);metricActive.textContent=String(projects.filter(p=>projectStatus(p)==='Active').length);metricOpen.textContent=String(tasks.filter(t=>t.status!=='Done').length);cardsEl.replaceChildren(...projects.map(p=>{const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.type='button';btn.className='t1-card'+(p.id===activeId?' is-active':'');btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(p.id===activeId));btn.dataset.projectId=p.id;const status=projectStatus(p);btn.innerHTML='

';btn.querySelector('h3').textContent=p.name||p.title||p.id;const badge=btn.querySelector('.t1-badge');badge.textContent=status;badge.dataset.status=status;btn.querySelector('.t1-meta').textContent=p.id===activeId?'Currently selected':'Click to open this project';btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{api.setState('activeProjectId',p.id);api.log(1,'Active project changed to '+(p.name||p.title||p.id));});return btn;}));}render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);root.addEventListener('bci:unmount',unsubscribe,{once:true});
